«§» The Hallow «§»


Map Name: The Hallow
Creators: MonsieurGray, AwarriorVenom (Spawn, Monument and Enchantment Structures)
Gamemode: Destroy the Monument
Team Info:
- Yellow vs Pink (Chaos vs Cosmos)
- 25 players per team
- 2 Monuments
General Info:
- Iron Stems with Glowing Diamond Flowers all around the map!
- Enchantment Tables in two different islands
- Floating Islands: No bedrock included!
- Glowing Mushrooms that contain a lot of neat stuff in them!
- Nature-friendly map!
- Ender Chests! Store special items you don't want to lose in these beautiful chests!
